caseNameFull: Poe v. Ullman, State's Attorney and Buxton v. Ullman, State's Attorney

opinions.text:
Appeals from the Supreme Court of Errors of Connecticut. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 362 U. S. 987.) The motion of the American Civil Liberties Union and the Connecticut Civil Liberties Union for leave to file brief, as amici curiae, is granted.

Mr. Justice Frankfurter took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion. Osmond K. Fraenkel for movants.
